dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: I came here because I was curious about the sweet dreams that Mother Goat can create... but what the heck is going on right now?
dialogues.text_zh: （雖然是好奇羊媽媽給予的幸福夢境才進來的……但現在這是什麼情況？）

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: You poor innocent child…
dialogues.text_zh: 可憐又無辜的孩子……

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: Being sentenced to death by the Queen of Hearts... you must be so terrified.
dialogues.text_zh: 要被紅心皇后處刑……你一定很害怕吧？

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: Don't worry, as long as you're here in mommy's embrace, nothing bad will ever happen to you.
dialogues.text_zh: 不過沒關係，只要在媽媽的懷裡，就不會發生可怕的事情哦。

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: Ugh...！I-I almost believed I really was her kid... this mind controlling spell is a lot stronger than I thought.
dialogues.text_zh: （唔……！差、差點以為自己真的是她的孩子……這精神魔法也太強烈了……！）

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: My dear baby！You grown so big already!
dialogues.text_zh: 我親愛的小寶貝……都已經長得這麼大了。

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: You can still cuddle with mommy as much as you want though~
dialogues.text_zh: 可以盡情跟媽媽撒嬌沒關係哦……？

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: Your body is swelling down there isn't it？You must be very confused.
dialogues.text_zh: 下半身膨脹成這樣，你一定很不知所措吧？

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: It's okay, this is perfectly normal.
dialogues.text_zh: 別怕，這些都是正常的。

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: This is your penis, and it can grow bigger, it's proof that you are a big healthy boy.
dialogues.text_zh: 這個是陰莖，陰莖會變大，是你健康長大的證明唷。

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: Ahah... it's getting even bigger?
dialogues.text_zh: 哎呀……竟然還可以變得更大嗎？

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: Mommy is so happy that her little boy is so gifted.
dialogues.text_zh: 媽媽有你這麼出色的孩子……很欣慰呢。

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: How about you show mommy how talented you are?
dialogues.text_zh: 讓媽媽看看你有多厲害，好不好？

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: It feels good, doesn't it？Once a little boy is all grown up, they need to learn how to make themselves feel good.
dialogues.text_zh: 很舒服吧？男孩子長大之後，就要自己學著讓自己舒服了……

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: If you can't do that yet, just ask mommy for help...♥
dialogues.text_zh: 要是不會的話，就來找媽媽幫忙吧……♥

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: (No, damn it... I can't hold back for much longer...)
dialogues.text_zh: （不、不行……已經忍耐不住了……）

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: M-Mommy?
dialogues.text_zh: 媽、媽媽……？

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: Boobs... so soft...
dialogues.text_zh: 胸部……好柔軟……

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: Yes... it's mommy.
dialogues.text_zh: 嗯……對哦，是媽媽哦。

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: How adorable, do you like mommy's boobs?
dialogues.text_zh: 真可愛，很喜歡媽媽的胸部吧？

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: That's alright, you have always been my little treasure since the moment you were born.
dialogues.text_zh: 沒關係，你從出生開始，就一直是媽媽最愛的小寶貝了。

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: Even if you're all grown up, you will always be my baby.♥
dialogues.text_zh: 就算長大也一樣……在媽媽眼中都是個孩子♥

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: See mommy's movements here？If you learn how to do this like a good boy, you can do this for yourself when mommy isn't around.
dialogues.text_zh: 媽媽這樣的動作……只要好好學起來，就算媽媽不在，自己也可以……

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: No... Mommy...！Don't leave me...!
dialogues.text_zh: 不要……媽媽……！不要離開我……！

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: I won't... mommy would never leave you, she would be so lonely if she did.♥
dialogues.text_zh: ……不會的，媽媽怎麼捨得離開自己心愛的孩子，那樣媽媽也會感到寂寞的♥

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: My, my, that went so far！Mommy is very impressed with her little boy.
dialogues.text_zh: 射得還真高！我家的孩子真了不起。

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: But there is probably more left in there, right？Mommy will have to make sure you get all cleaned out...
dialogues.text_zh: 不過裡面應該還有吧？需要好好排乾淨才……

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: Wow, so, amazing… who knew mommy's little boy was so talented.
dialogues.text_zh: 哈……好、好厲害……媽媽的孩子竟然這麼優秀……♥

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: Even as a big boy you know to cum in mommy's face♥
dialogues.text_zh: 長大了，還知道要顏射媽媽了♥

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: If you made me yours, you would make me very happy, wouldn't you?
dialogues.text_zh: 如果成為你的女人，一定會很幸福吧？

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: I don't, don't want anyone else... I just want my mommy...
dialogues.text_zh: 不要，不要其他人……只要媽媽……

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: Mommy can be my woman, I love you mommy...
dialogues.text_zh: 媽媽當我的女人就好，最喜歡媽媽了……

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: Hearing you say that… makes mommy so happy... it's making my breast milk come out♥
dialogues.text_zh: 聽到孩子這麼說……媽媽好開心……母乳會忍不住出來的♥

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: Ah... because I must take care of my baby...
dialogues.text_zh: 哈啊……為了照顧小寶寶……

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: Milk is, is coming out♥ Because of my baby... my body feels young again…...♥
dialogues.text_zh: 母乳出、出來了♥因為小寶寶……身體又變得年輕了……♥

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: Seeing my little boy shoot out so much healthy-looking semen, makes mommy very happy... it tastes delicious too!
dialogues.text_zh: 能讓孩子射出這麼濃稠又健康的精液，媽媽很高興哦……味道也很棒呢！

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: No, it's not enough... I want more... mommy...
dialogues.text_zh: 不、不夠……還想要更多……媽媽……

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: Phew... well, since you're asking so nicely...
dialogues.text_zh: 呼呼……既然是寶貝孩子的請求……

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: I could only be a mommy because you were born, honey...
dialogues.text_zh: 媽媽因為你的誕生，才能成為媽媽……

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: Now my little darling, you must help mommy turn back into a woman, okay?
dialogues.text_zh: 現在我親愛的小寶貝，來把媽媽變回女人，好不好？

dialogues.speaker: Mother Goat
dialogues.text: You can't argue with mommy, mother always knows best...♥
dialogues.text_zh: 不可以拒絕媽媽，要聽媽媽的話才行哦……♥
